subject: maths
question: 22 men can complete a piece of work in 7(1)/(2) days. How many men will be required to complete the same work in 5(1)/(2) days?
solution:
**Given:**

22 men can complete a piece of work in 7(1)/(2) days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Total number of men × Total number of days required

**Calculation:**

Let, total work = 22 × 15 / 2

⇒ 11 × 15 = 165 units

So, the number of men will be required to complete the same work in 5(1)/(2) 

⇒ 11 / 2 days 

⇒ (165)/(11/2)

⇒ (165 × 2 )/ 11

⇒ 15 × 2 = 30 men

**∴ 30 men will be required to complete the same work in 5(1)/(2) days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Formula used:

Work = Men × Days.

**Calculation:**

22 men × 7(1)/(2) days = men × 5(1)/(2) days

⇒ 22 × 15/2 = men × 11/2

⇒ 15 × 2 = **30 men.**
